notes.title: REMOTE PLAY IS HERE!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing A Sound Plan!

After much delay, and with much fanfare, we wanna let you know that you can now play with your friends across the internet via Remote Play!

When you start the game, just invite your friends from your friends list, and there you go!
We sincerely hope you continue to enjoy A Sound Plan.

What are you waiting for? Feed your friends to zombies, but across cyberspace!
